## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Every AC in the table has a test that really checks it
- [ ] If an endpoint was added or changed, the Swagger docs are updated
- [ ] If a team rule changed, AGENTS.md and the QA Manual are updated
- [ ] The PR has assignees (everyone who made commits) and a reviewer who is not the author
- [ ] No secrets or personal data, only synthetic test data
